note: All AISLER specifications are published as staff-authored articles on community.aisler.net (AISLER's own Discourse site, linked from aisler.net). Top-level = 4 Layer 35 µm ENIG product rules. min_via_diameter_mm 0.45 is DERIVED (0.25 mm via drill + 2 x 100 µm via annular ring); no via pad diameter is stated. min_drill_mm is the via drill; component (PTH) drills start at 0.5 mm with 300 µm ring. min_solder_mask_clearance_mm 0.05 is the 'suggested soldermask expansion', not a stated minimum. 2-layer HASL is coarser (200/150 µm, 0.3 mm drill). impedance_control null: AISLER publishes impedance width tables for its 4/6/8-layer stackups as 'basic orientation' but no controlled-impedance service or tolerance on the pages read.
barrel_plating_source-s: AISLER staff (Thea) in 'Via Plating Thickness' thread, 2023-08-16: 'The plating is ~18-25µm' https://community.aisler.net/t/2960 ; another staff reply 2024-04-22: 'Plating holes add around 22 µm of bare copper' (stated as from memory) https://community.aisler.net/t/3928 ; press-fit holes (4 L 1.6 mm ENIG pool only): 'minimum copper thickness of 25 µm' https://community.aisler.net/t/4429 ; read 2026-10-17. Forum answers, not a formal specification.

stack.er-s: printed '4.00' for this middle core while the other two cores read '4.4' - copied as printed

stackups_note: Stackups are images on the topic pages (viewed directly); each dielectric ply is listed separately with its own εr, kept as separate prepreg entries. The 4 Layers 1.6mm 35µm stackup (2x1080 70 µm / Core FR4 1200 µm / 2x1080, all copper 35 µm) is EXCLUDED because its εr column is printed as ranges ('4.0 - 4.3' prepreg, '4.5 - 4.6' core). As a result the first (and only) 4-layer stackup is the 0.8 mm build, so a 1.6 mm 4-layer board has no matching stackup here. 2-layer and 4-layer 70 µm products are 'variable' (no stackup). In the 8-layer image the middle core (IN3-IN4) is printed 'εr 4.00' while the outer cores are '4.4'; copied as printed (may be a typo). Layer order: 6L 1.6, 8L 1.6, 4L 0.8.
